statement.p: Use Green's Theorem to calculate the circulation of \vec F = 3xy\,\vec i around the rectangle 0\le x\le 8, 0\le y\le 8, oriented counterclockwise.

static.solution: R representing the interior of the square, \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_R\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(0)-\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(3xy)\right)\,dA = \int_R -3x\,dA. Thus the circulation is \int_C\vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_0^{8}\int_0^{8} -3x\,dy\,dx = -768.
